| title | P1476 | P102_has_title |
| creator | P170 | P14_carried_out_by |
| date | P571 | P108_has_produced |
| materials | P186 | P45_consists_of |
| inventory_number | P217 | P1_is_identified_by |
| location | P276 | — |
